mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation exceeds 3.0%, the Federal Reserve initiates monetary tightening, increasing bond yields and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline >2% MoM, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 4.0%), a UNRATE rise above 4.5% signals imminent economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings growth decelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO above 12-month moving average) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeding 3.0% YoY signals robust economic momentum, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary policy constraint regimes (FEDFUNDS < 1.0% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), the Fed's limited ability to ease policy causes market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.
